fields.name: model_number
fields.instruction: Extract the exact product model number explicitly written in the document. Do not infer. If not found return NC.

fields.name: voltage
fields.instruction: Extract electrical voltage only, such as 115V or 230V. Do not extract frequency values like 50Hz or 60Hz. If not found return SS.

fields.name: capacity
fields.instruction: Extract storage capacity only, such as liters or cubic feet. Do not extract weight or power. If not found return NA.
